claim: Threshold/rainfall-triggered warning may be insufficient when the trigger is upstream out of sight; Kashmir study shows ice-contact lake area up 26% 1992-2024, 155 lakes mapped, 5 very high GLOF susceptibility.
quoted_support: waiting for rainfall or a rising river may not provide enough time when the real trigger happens several kilometres upstream and above the line of sight of the communities below.
stance_target: Warning dissemination gaps are a key improvement area
